_readme: Price table used to show the estimated cost before anything paid runs. Prices change and depend on your plan: VERIFY each one on the provider's pricing page and edit here. 'verificado' = date you checked it (null = not checked). Local providers cost 0 (GPU time only).

elevenlabs_tts.nota: credits per character on eleven_v3; the effective price depends on the subscription tier

elevenlabs_sts.nota: speech-to-speech is billed by audio length in credits

nano_banana.nota: Gemini image output, per generated image at ~1 MP

seedance.nota: depends on model tier (lite/pro) and resolution; resellers differ

suno.nota: via a gateway; plus the Suno plan needed for commercial use

krea.nota: compute units; the MCP shows real cost

flora.nota: the Flora MCP returns run_cost in USD: trust that over this

claude.nota: 0 when Claude Code runs on a subscription; set your API rate if you use an API key

uso_tipico_artist_short._readme: What one artist Short consumes; the estimator uses the real script when it exists.
